Title: Cart Persistence - Cross-Device (Cross-Session)
Preconditions:
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:ORG_USER_DEFAULT]
[PRE:RESET_CART]
Simulate two devices with two real, fully isolated browser contexts (separate engines so cookies/localStorage/IndexedDB cannot be shared) — Device A = playwright-chrome, Device B = playwright-firefox. Same registered user logs in independently in each context (no session/state copied between them).
Steps:
[NAV] log in to {{FRONT_URL}} as {{USER_EMAIL}} in playwright-chrome browser context (Device A)
[ACT] add two or more products to cart on Device A
[WAIT] wait for cart badge to update and confirm items persisted (server sync, not just local state)
[NAV] open a second, fully isolated browser context in playwright-firefox (Device B)
[ACT] log in to {{FRONT_URL}} with the same {{USER_EMAIL}} credentials (no cookies/storage carried over from Device A)
[NAV] navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/cart in the Device B context
Assertions:
[STATE] Device B cart (separate browser engine, no shared cookies/localStorage/IndexedDB) shows identical line items and quantities to Device A — proves server-side persistence, not client-side storage
[DOM] cart badge count on Device B matches Device A (visible)
[STATE] cart synchronized via the server-side account, not via localStorage carried between contexts
[STATE] verify Device B cart shows the same items and quantities that were added on Device A
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[API] Device B's underlying getCart query response errors[] is empty; lineItems count matches Device A
[CONSOLE] no JS errors in either browser context
[NETWORK] no 4xx/5xx on cart fetch in either context
Failure_Signals: Device B cart is empty or missing items added on Device A; quantity mismatch between the two contexts; Device B requires re-adding items (indicates reliance on client-side storage instead of server-side persistence)
Cleanup: Remove items from cart in both browser contexts; close both contexts
